total_process_count.extraction_method: Unique integer PIDs present in EPROCESS doubly-linked active list
total_process_count.rationale: Direct baseline process count; zero corruption; non-constant across runs

hidden_process_count.aggregation_method: Count of unlinked carved process structures
hidden_process_count.rationale: High-confidence indicator of direct kernel object manipulation (DKOM) and process unlinking

anomalous_ppid_count.extraction_method: Lineage rules: scripting hosts spawned by core daemons or missing parent PIDs
anomalous_ppid_count.aggregation_method: Count of lineage anomaly instances per run
anomalous_ppid_count.rationale: Detects parent PID spoofing and process creation hijacking without label leakage

total_handle_count_non_system.extraction_method: Total handle table entries excluding MsMpEng, System, lsass, services, csrss, svchost
total_handle_count_non_system.rationale: Continuous variation in every run (45 unique values); eliminates Defender 14,000 handle distortion

process_all_access_handles.extraction_method: Filter Type=='Process' and GrantedAccess contains 0x1fffff in non-system processes
process_all_access_handles.aggregation_method: Count of full access process handles
process_all_access_handles.rationale: Indicates handle acquisition for cross-process memory manipulation (VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory)

cross_process_handles.extraction_method: Filter Type=='Process' where handle name references target PID distinct from owning process
cross_process_handles.aggregation_method: Count of target PID references across userland processes
cross_process_handles.rationale: Measures inter-process surveillance and injection targeting

elevated_privilege_count_non_system.extraction_method: Filter high-risk privileges (SeDebug, SeImpersonate, SeTcb) Enabled/Present in non-system processes
elevated_privilege_count_non_system.aggregation_method: Count of high-risk privilege grants in userland
elevated_privilege_count_non_system.rationale: Reflects token privilege escalation attempts while ignoring OS daemons

unlinked_dll_count.extraction_method: Filter InLoad==False and InMem==True across all processes
unlinked_dll_count.aggregation_method: Sum of unlinked PE modules in memory
unlinked_dll_count.rationale: Signature of reflective DLL injection and manual PE loading; 0 in benign runs

raw_command_text.extraction_method: Binary EVTX parsing, background OS daemon filtering, chronological session text concatenation
raw_command_text.rationale: Primary NLP input for DistilBERT fine-tuning on contextual command syntax

command_event_count.extraction_method: Count of Sysmon Event ID 1 ProcessCreate records in session
command_event_count.rationale: Continuous distribution (45 unique values); captures process churning during malware staging

scriptblock_event_count.rationale: Measures volume of dynamic script evaluation; 0% missingness

filtered_event_count.extraction_method: Combined event count after excising OS system noise and PSReadLine prompts
filtered_event_count.rationale: Measures density of interactive and payload command invocations

command_length.extraction_method: Total character length of combined filtered command payloads
command_length.rationale: Reflects execution volume and script size in session telemetry

outbound_connection_count.extraction_method: Count of outbound TCP/UDP network connections excluding multicast/broadcast
outbound_connection_count.rationale: Real continuous telemetry; separates benign baseline (243-279) from malware activity (280-404)

suspicious_port_usage.extraction_method: Count of outbound connections to non-standard ports (excluding 80, 443, 53, etc.)
suspicious_port_usage.rationale: Detects C2 communication over unusual listener ports

scripting_process_network_count.extraction_method: Connections where Image is powershell, cmd, rundll32, wmic, or mshta
scripting_process_network_count.rationale: Classic living-off-the-land fileless download and reverse shell indicator

listening_port_anomaly_count.extraction_method: Listening sockets (State==Listen) on ports not in Windows 11 standard baseline
listening_port_anomaly_count.rationale: Detects local backdoor listener sockets; 0 in benign runs

non_defender_malfind_regions.extraction_method: Count of PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE or VadS regions where Process != MsMpEng.exe
non_defender_malfind_regions.rationale: Eliminates Defender's 14-15 RWX false positive regions while preserving genuine userland injections

non_defender_commit_charge.extraction_method: Sum of CommitCharge across non-Defender malfind regions
non_defender_commit_charge.rationale: Measures physical memory allocation of suspicious executable regions

unmapped_executable_vad_count.extraction_method: Executable VADs with no file backing (File in N/A, None, Disabled) excluding MsMpEng
unmapped_executable_vad_count.rationale: Detects memory-only PE injection and unbacked shellcode stagers

vad_protection_anomalies.extraction_method: PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE VADs in processes other than MsMpEng and OneDrive
vad_protection_anomalies.rationale: Direct violation of W^X (Write XOR Execute) memory protection policy

ldrmodules_unlinked_dll_count.rationale: Cross-modality reinforcement of PE unlinking; 0% missingness
